research_question: Can a causally detected accumulation range create a local volume-profile POC that becomes an executable continuation anchor after confirmed breakout, pullback, and POC reclaim, under frozen 30-second P75 execution?
rationale: Completed R037 meta-harvest repeatedly favors durable anchors plus delayed causal confirmation/retest over naked breakouts, raw indicators, and first-touch fades.

PVACVD showed prior-day auction edges had ample supply but negative 30-second economics; this unit is structurally distinct because the profile is built only from the pre-break accumulation that generated the breakout.
The tested public mechanism is explicitly a state machine: compression -> local profile -> confirmed breakout -> POC pullback -> confirmed continuation through POC.

source_basis.source: TradingView open-source Volume Profile Breakout Continuation
source_basis.use: state-machine grammar: causal accumulation, local profile, confirmed breakout, POC-zone pullback, confirmed POC continuation trigger; confirmed bars/non-repainting
independent MT5 evidence that POC-zone retest mechanics are implementable for XAUUSD; not used for proprietary thresholds
secondary qualitative support for waiting for retest/hold/confirmation rather than first-touch entries

source_default_disclosure: TradingView indexed text exposes parameter categories but not numeric defaults. Numeric fixtures below are project-defined bounded research fixtures and are NOT represented as source defaults.

common_mechanism.accumulation: On completed bar, rolling N-bar high-low range <= compression_multiple * ATR14 opens an accumulation box; box grows while completed bars remain inside. Abandon if expanded box range > abandon_multiple * ATR14 or age exceeds max_box_bars.
common_mechanism.profile: Within completed accumulation bars, each bar's tick count is distributed evenly across 24 equal price rows spanned by that bar. POC is max-volume row with deterministic lower-price tie break; 70% value area expands outward from POC with lower-price tie break.
common_mechanism.breakout: First confirmed close outside box freezes POC/VAL/VAH and breakout direction.
common_mechanism.pullback: Within max_wait bars, bar range must touch POC +/- poc_zone_fraction * frozen box height; close through far value-area edge invalidates.
common_mechanism.trigger: After a pullback touch, first confirmed close back through POC in breakout direction with directional candle enters at first executable P75 tick at/after bar end.
